about: A Codex column's plan on whatever floor the server opens; sends nothing. Run with ?tick=1&minimap=inline. Where a Codex session on the floor has a plan (its update_plan calls, read from its rollout; with gpt-6-luna on codex-cli 0.167 they stand inside the JavaScript of its `exec` calls, providers/plans.py), its column carries the progress line ('2/3 · the current step', or '3/3 · done'); a click focuses it, and its checklist opens (at once while it runs, by ≡ once it has finished) with one row per step in the plan's order, its count matching the steps done; Esc closes it; on the mini-map no row carries both an attention icon and the progress ring. Where no Codex column has a plan, every step is skipped and logged. Measured first on a scratch project with one real gpt-6-luna run (2026-11-09: three steps, three updates).
